title: ON.energy pinned scroll scene
description: A pinned, several-windows-tall scroll scene: a full-window dark stage sticks while you scroll, with a light two-line title and a glass button on the left at mid-height and a short two-tone copy at the bottom. As you scroll the title's letters blur and fade away one by one, the button fades and the media slowly pulls back from 1.2× to 1×.
notes: media slot: a full-window video, image sequence or 3D canvas; empty, a dark stage with a soft floor light stands in
the section is `screens` windows tall (8 on the original); everything scrubs with one CSS view timeline
made for a dark backdrop; off under reduced motion
name: on-energy-showcase
